maya: quick pass on the callouts panel — spotted a few keyboard + SR nits after the latest build. attaching notes. maya: primary issue: radio groups for model selection lose visible focus when you tab between them (looks like focus ring is the same color as the bg in dark theme). also VoiceOver announces 'button' on each item instead of 'radio' or 'option'. devon: ack — can you paste a screenshot? i couldn't repro locally but maybe it's theme-specific. maya: screenshot: https://figma.redwood.design/file/ABC123/callouts-panel — you can repro in dark theme at 120% zoom. sophie: fyi this is classic focus contrast + role problem. two quick fixes: 1) ensure focus-visible uses a high-contrast outline color; 2) set role="radiogroup" on the container and role="radio" + aria-checked on each item. devon: ok adding to queue. thinking small CSS tweak first: devon: ```css .callout-radio:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd166; /* warmer high-contrast ring */ outline-offset: 2px; } ``` sophie: that helps visually but VoiceOver will still read 'button' unless the semantics are corrected. markup should be something like: sophie: ```html
Small
Medium
``` maya: also noticed that when a radio is selected via mouse, keyboard focus doesn't move to the checked item (keyboard nav loses sync). tabindex management is off. devon: thanks — i'll update keyboard handling: click sets tabindex on the selected radio to 0 and others to -1, and focus moves to the selected element. jorge: small product nit: when users switch models in this panel we should surface a polite SR announcement like "Model switched to Medium — latency approx 120ms" so assistive users get feedback. not an alert, just polite. sophie: agree. use an aria-live region with polite. keep copy short and avoid numeric jitter (round latencies). maya: suggested code for announcer: maya: ```html
``` devon: will implement. question: is it ok to include latency in the announcement or should we avoid numbers? jorge: include approximate latency but round to nearest 50ms to avoid too-frequent changes when measurements fluctuate. maya: another small a11y: keyboard users in the panel expecting arrow-key nav between radios — currently left/right do nothing. we should support arrow navigation per WAI-ARIA authoring practices. devon: adding arrow key handler and role semantics. will add tests. sophie: testing checklist for QA: - VoiceOver: confirm items announced as radio + state (checked/unchecked) - ChromeVox and NVDA: same behavior - Focus ring visible in dark & light at 200% zoom - Arrow keys move selection and update aria-checked - Mouse click moves focus and sets tabindex correctly - SR polite announcement fires once per selection change maya: thanks team. i'm going to update the Figma notes with the new visual token and add the aria examples. tagging @aria-bot for a11y-lint after dev patch. :thumbsup: aria-bot: a11y-lint queued for branch 'callouts/a11y-radio-fix' — running checklist: roles, focus, contrast, aria-live. you will get results in CI. devon: sounds good — i'll push a WIP PR later today and include the CSS/markup snippets. maya: perfect — i'll do a quick follow-up review once the PR is up. thanks!
